name: Editorial Forest
description: Quiet editorial presentation master with forest green, dusty pink, and warm cream for reflective student reports, research recaps, and course presentations.

font_strategy.cjk_fallback: Noto Serif SC or Microsoft YaHei

readability_scale.target: classroom projection readable at approximately 3 meters

render_strategy.notes: Rendered through the deck-stage API. Navigation chrome is hidden before screenshot capture. Text box outlines are rewritten to DrawingML noFill for LibreOffice and WPS compatibility.

rescue_notes: Rebuilt as an HTML-background hybrid master following the corrected noFill text-box standard. Frontend and Writer consume visual_master=editorial_forest.
